MW development-rig depends on no Pi package.

Conclusion 'no first-class function dispatch / no Pi->Mechanical invocation' is over-determined: it follows from C0162/C0179 alone. Scope note: Pi DOES ship a Mechanical boundary (collective-event.ts, provider 'mechanical-workflows', present at baseline f67b6665) that admits MW collective.event.v1 envelopes; 'no Mechanical binding' is true only with the qualifier 'no invocation/host binding'.

No Mechanical function-invocation binding, loader or host adapter is registered or imported at the pin; the absence is detected by grep over src/ for the MW package names, descriptor id and 'mechanical' (the only src hits are collective-event.ts, an unwired envelope reader, and a prose word in tool-description.ts).
